v) Nonetheless, any charges borne by the Service Provider with respe ct to toll charges, parking fee or entry taxes shall be reimbursed on an actual basis upon submission of proof of payment. vi) All the deductions/ fine/ interest (if applicable) will be settled befor e making the payments. Service Provider shall not have any objection on the same. 5.0 PRICES/RATES: The item prices are “FIRM & FIRM” in all respect throughout the currency of the supply order but exclusive of Government Taxes/Duties and the same will be p aid extra on submission of proof of its payment. No variation in the rates will b e allowed at any cost and the prices/rates should be FOR destination / includin g all cost. 6.0 VARIATION OF SUPPLY : Variation is generally not allowed. However, in case of any Supply which is n ot written in BOQ or specification and required to complete the Supply accordi ng to standard practice and mutually agreed a variation of +/- 10% shall have to be executed by the firm with approval of competent authority. 7.0 SECURITY DEPOSIT 1) In order to secure/assure the fulfillment of the supply, the successful tenderer , upon receipt of preliminary acceptance letter/detailed purchase order as the c ase may be, shall furnish within15days,a security amount equivalent to 1% of t he contract value in the form of FDR/CDR/BG in favour of the ordering authority or as directed valid for six (6) months. 2) The amount of Earnest Money (EMD) may be converted in to security deposit. 3) The security money shall be released after successful completion of supply a nd having successful completion certificate of the Executive Engineer concerned. 4) The security money shall be forfeited either in whole or imparted the absolute discretion of the Engineer, if the Supplier fails or neglect to observe or perform a ny his obligation under the contract. 8.0 PERFORMANCE SECURITY (CPBG) i) Within Twenty-eight (28) days of the receipt of PO, the Bidder shall be required to furnish a Contract Performance Bank Guarantee (as per prescri bed format) issued by a scheduled commercial bank of India in favor of the Executive Engineer (A) , ETC Ghaziabad. ii) The Bank Guarantee is a composite one. It acts as Security against the risk to wards Successful Performance. The Performance period shall be One year for the Supply. iii) The Contract Performance Bank Guarantee (CPBG) amount shall be e qual to ten percent (10%) of the Contract Price (Including GST) for 1 ye ar + 45 Days. However, if the Bid value is less than 10% of Estimated v alue, additional security of 01% Bid value for every 1% decrease 90% of estimated Bid value shall be added over and above 10% CPBG. iv) It the supply completion period gets extended, the Contract Performance Ba nk Guarantee shall be extended accordingly. In case the contract price gets revi sed over and above ten percent, the Contractor shall submit the enhanced Bank Guarantee to that effect. v) The aforesaid CPBG shall be returned to the supplier after successful complet

ion of the guarantee obligations under the contract. vi) In case the successful bidder fails to submit the CPBG within the schedule ti me or even after extension of time allowed to him, the Letter of Award (LOA) is to be cancelled and EMD will be forfeited. 9.0 COMPLETION PERIOD: The maximum completion period of the order will be 15 Days. 10.0 PENALTY: Penalty for delay incompletion of supply shall be levied @ ½ % per week subj ect to a maximum of 10% value of total agreement value shall be deducted fro m the firm's bills. 11.0 CONSIGNEE: The covered material under the supply order shall be supervised by the concer ned Executive Engineer. 12.0 LIABILITY: Any loss/theft of department material, shall be of the responsibility/liability of Contractor due to negligence or otherwise the cost of which shall be recovered from the Contractor's bill. 13.0 INCOME TAX : Income tax shall be deducted from the firm’s bill in accordance with Govt. of In dia rules. 14.0 GST : GST shall be paid extra as in accordance with Govt. of India rules legally applic able against GST Invoice. 18.0 QUALITY OF MATERIAL/ INSPECTION: Material should be of standard quality and genuine in accordance with Indian S tandard as applicable and should be under warranty. The material shall be ins pected before delivery at works except if waiver is issued by department as pe r relevant IS. 19.0 NEGLIGENCE : If any time it is felt that supplier is unable to execute the supply in accordance with the specification or as per written instructions given to him by the Engine er of the contract/Engineer In charge or the progress and quality of material of the supplier is found unsatisfactory a notice of 07 days will be given to the sup plier to make good failure and if the supplier shall fail to comply the notice with a reasonable time, supply order will be taken away from them wholly or part a s a case may be, by terminating the order and supplier will have no claim over it, the remaining supply will be get executed by some other agency and the su pplier be liable to bear the extra cost which department has to pay.

20.0 ARBITRATION/SETTLEMENT OF DISPUTE : In case of any dispute between the supplier and Engineer In charge the matter shall be referred to Superintending Engineer, ETC , UPPTCL, Ghaziabad whose decision shall be final and binding on both the parties. 21.0 OTHERS: Debarment/Blacklisting against firm may be done as per UPPTCL policy in c ase of default. 22.0 Bidder must submit a self-declaration on Non Judicial stamp paper o f Rs. 100/- as per details /Performa given. 23.0 TERMINATION OF SUPPLY ORDER : Engineer of contract has right to terminate the order for any reason by giving the supplier a notice of termination.
